pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.bottleneckHint: Inferred from where the transfer pipe waits — repository back-pressure vs waiting on the guest read / LAN. A best-effort read of the pipeline, not a hardware measurement.

caption.staging: Reading and staging the source image on the appliance — the transfer to the target host starts next.
caption.replicaRate: Writing <1>{{rate}}</1> into the replica’s virtual disk on the target host{{wire}} — no repository, no dedup pass.
caption.replicaBlocks: Writing changed blocks into the replica’s virtual disk on the target host{{wire}} — no repository, no dedup pass.
caption.incremental: Reconstructing image at <1>{{rate}}</1> logical — an incremental re-emits the full image from the repository over localhost, so this isn’t wire or repo-write throughput.
caption.processing: Processing <1>{{rate}}</1> of the guest image; repository write is the physical footprint after dedup + compression.
caption.fallback: Repository write is physical bytes after dedup + compression.
